text.p: Thieves lifted and separated 11,000 bras from a Sydney warehouse but missed the bottom halves of the matching sets, police said on Friday.
The ivory-coloured satin and lace bras were taken from the city's Kolotex factory some time last week, police said.

Kolotex spokesman Graham Newman said the bras, which sell for A$40 (US$31.60) in department stores and speciality boutiques, were likely to find their way to markets and street stalls before Christmas.
The company, meanwhile, was in talks with Chinese suppliers to get new tops for the thousands of ivory-coloured bikini bottoms, g-strings and suspender belts left on its shelves.
